units.text: Emancipation Proclamation signed January 1, 1863, by Lincoln in Washington, D.C. Span 9 of e4b7abf5 confirms the date and context; Span 10 of 61bbec9c confirms signing date and subject; Spans 8 and 45 of 0ddaee4b confirm celebration on that date.
